findings.text: non-blocking: the control paragraph says both runs 'and the tool's listing over the worktree itself, are recorded by the script that produces them', naming logs/negative_control.sh, logs/negative-control.log and logs/inventory-current.log together, but logs/negative_control.sh ends after its two scratch-copy invocations and never runs the tool over the worktree, so logs/inventory-current.log cannot be regenerated from the script the paragraph points a reader at.

justifications.durability: tests/test_operand_cache.py:122-126 fails if OPERAND_CACHE_ROOT is restored to sophelio and tests/test_filepath_data_roots.py:35 does the same for LABELLER_SESSION_ROOT, but nothing guards the roughly 80 script and benchmark defaults, and scripts/prototypes/shared_root/inventory.py is a one-shot tool that no test invokes, so a future edit can reintroduce the retired root in those files without a red test.
justifications.evidence: Clause (1) reproduces independently at 23fa51437 (0 default and 29 corpus references, corpus lines byte-identical to the base), clause (2) is carried by logs/base-arm.log and logs/head-arm-at-0d6b98b3a.log with the same six FAILED ids, and clause (3) is stated in the manifest and confirmed against the command stream; it loses points because tests/test_operand_cache.py exits 137 in both arms and is cut short, so the arm pair does not measure the file the new assertion lives in.
justifications.fit: The added test follows the module's existing monkeypatch-and-assert idiom at tests/test_operand_cache.py:114, inventory.py carries module-docstring usage and no plan label, ticket id or version suffix appears in any changed path, and the AGENTS.md prose edit restates the mechanism rather than naming a run or a section.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The landed change does exactly what the goal names: nova/database/filepath.py:24 and :82 move the two library defaults to the new root and the 86 remaining tracked defaults move only the root segment, verified by every head sub-path appearing unchanged under imas_gpu/nova.
justifications.reuse: No owner of a reference-inventory capability exists: a search of scripts/, nova/ and benchmarks/ for git-grep scanning and inventory helpers found none, and the landed inventory.py is the first, while the library constants extend the modules that already own them rather than duplicating a path-helper mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 789479f7d..23fa51437 lists 85 paths and every one is under nova/, scripts/, benchmarks/, tests/, apps/playable/machines.py, AGENTS.md or the one declared evidence fragment, with no docs/ plan, state or figure edit.
